graph.max_parents_status: Implemented bound for this provisional topology, pending domain review
conditional_independences: All feature nodes except the oldpeak/slope pair are mutually independent conditional on disease
Slope is independent of other features conditional on disease and oldpeak
All oldpeak/slope dependencies on the other features are mediated by disease in this model
graph.conditional_independences_status: Explicit strong modeling assumptions, not empirically established

parameter_estimation.proposal: Discrete CPTs with symmetric Dirichlet smoothing estimated only on permitted training rows
parameter_estimation.alpha_semantics: Pseudocount per child state per parent configuration, not an unspecified equivalent-sample-size setting
parameter_estimation.estimator_library: Existing NumPy/pandas; local CPT counting and exact sum-product branch inference

discretization.policy: After training-only median imputation, compute 1/3 and 2/3 empirical quantiles; deduplicate and remove cuts at observed extrema. Intervals are left-closed at cuts (searchsorted side=right), with unbounded exterior intervals. Constant columns have one state. Reject nonfinite values and all-missing training columns.
requirements: Clinical cutoffs require a directly supporting source
Any learned cut points must be fitted inside each training fold
Define interval boundaries, tied cut points, out-of-range values and all-missing training columns
No numeric bin values may be chosen from C, T or held-out-hospital outcomes

missing_values.training_proposal: Training-only median/mode imputation before CPT counts; mode ties use first declared category; all-missing training columns raise ValueError
missing_values.inference_proposal: Omit unavailable observations from evidence and marginalize their nodes using the fitted joint distribution
missing_values.invalid_categories: Reject invalid values; do not silently treat invalid categories as missing clinical evidence
missing_values.unseen_valid_states: Use the frozen state vocabulary and smoothed CPTs; unseen numeric values use frozen interval definitions
assumptions: Imputed training values are an approximation and suppress missing-value uncertainty
Inference marginalization does not repair bias in imputation-based parameter estimates
Site-dependent missingness may be informative; neither ignorability nor clinical validity has been established

inference.proposal: Exact sum-product marginalization specialized to disease -> features plus oldpeak -> slope; sum missing independent leaves to one and explicitly sum the oldpeak/slope branch
inference.no_evidence_behavior: Return fitted marginal P(disease), not necessarily a root CPT

unresolved_assumptions.needs: Faculty confirmation and source definitions; distinguish existing disease classification from future risk
Literature passages plus explicit statistical/causal interpretation; no age-to-sex edge inherited from the audit
Individual dependency/orientation justification; do not adopt a universal disease-to-all-features scaffold
Evidence or accepted modeling assumptions for each proposed edge, including any oldpeak/slope relationship
Explicit independence list and limitations, including demographic effects conditional on disease
Fixed source-supported or fold-learned policy, parent bound, free-parameter count and sparse-cell treatment
Review imputation/marginalization approximation and site-missingness limitations; define edge-case behavior

unresolved_assumptions.topic: Prior, library and final search grid
unresolved_assumptions.needs: Choose alpha grid, compatible implementation and estimation semantics before comparative runs

graph.evidence_policy: No edge is literature-supported without a checked source passage; association evidence does not establish causal orientation; retain unaccepted proposals outside edges
approval_requirements: Faculty scope questions resolved where material
Every edge has a complete reviewed evidence/assumption record
States, parent bound, binning, missing-data policy and alpha grid finalized
graph.execution_scope: Explicit allow_provisional=True opt-in; only synthetic fitting authorized in Stage 2; no faculty approval or real-data experiment authorization
graph.provisional_topology_rationale: A class-conditional generative scaffold plus one dependence between recorded ST-test descriptors. This is a provisional statistical model, not an accepted medical causal graph.
